name: Smolderbank Array
text:
Whenever a red source you control deals exactly 1 noncombat damage to an opponent, put a charge counter on Smolderbank Array.
{T}, Remove a charge counter from Smolderbank Array: Add {R}. Spend this mana only to cast instant or sorcery spells.
{2}{R}, {T}, Remove two charge counters from Smolderbank Array: Copy target red instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
